title: mlflow-artifacts tracking URI error: strip credentials from the URI before putting it in the message
answers: Why does the tracing exporter log a database password in a WARNING when the server runs with --serve-artifacts?
Why is my tracking URI with a password or odbc_connect PWD showing up in the mlflow-artifacts 'tracking URI must be a valid http or https URI' error?
Where is the check that rejects non-http tracking URIs for mlflow-artifacts artifact URIs handled?
If I add another error that prints the tracking URI, how should I keep secrets out of it?
body:
Path: mlflow/store/artifact/mlflow_artifacts_repo.py:_validate_uri_scheme is the chokepoint reached from MlflowArtifactsRepository.resolve_uri when an mlflow-artifacts:/ artifact URI is resolved against a tracking URI whose scheme is not http/https. In the tracking server the tracking URI is the backend store URI, so this path also runs for in-process trace export.
Rule: never interpolate a raw tracking URI into an exception message. Build a redacted copy first: take parsed_uri.netloc.rpartition("@") to drop userinfo, and use parsed_uri._replace(netloc=..., params="", query="", fragment="").geturl() so query-string secrets (e.g. odbc_connect=...PWD=...) are dropped too. Keep scheme, host, port and path so the message stays actionable.
Symptom: with the tracking server started with --serve-artifacts and a credentialed database URI such as postgresql://user:password@host/db, the tracing exporter logged the exception at WARNING and the database password appeared in cleartext in stdout, which log aggregators retain.
Constraints: the redaction drops query, params and fragment for every URI that reaches this error, not only URIs with userinfo, so a non-credentialed URI that has a query string is also shortened in the message. The error still fires only for schemes other than http/https; valid http/https tracking URIs are unaffected.
applies: Applies to the mlflow-artifacts artifact repository's tracking-URI scheme validation and to any new error or log message in the tracking/tracing path that prints a backend store or tracking URI.
says: Database passwords appear in plain text within server warning logs during artifact operations.
Redact sensitive connection credentials from tracking service error messages before printing them.
The tracking server console log exposes database user credentials when artifact validation fails.
Prevent database connection strings with passwords from leaking into artifact repository error alerts.
search: MlflowArtifactsRepository._validate_uri_scheme must redact userinfo and query parameters from tracking URIs before interpolating them into exception messages. When running the tracking server with --serve-artifacts, raw database URIs containing cleartext passwords were logged to stdout at WARNING level during invalid scheme errors. Redaction strips userinfo via netloc partitioning and clears query, params, and fragment while preserving scheme, host, port, and path for non-http tracking URIs.
